H01-S01-C01.beat: A last heartbeat ends and the camera plunges into the city-sized Pit before a chain cracks into the suffering crowd.
H01-S01-C01.dialogueAnchor: No dialogue; heartbeat, screams, iron and fire.
H01-S01-C01.cameraMovement: Vertical plunge accelerating into forward Steadicam
H01-S01-C01.transition: Fade in from black; cut on chain crack

H01-S01-C02.beat: Water becomes steam, jailers drive souls against burning iron, and a barbed-chain wipe reveals prison bars and approaching bare footsteps.
H01-S01-C02.dialogueAnchor: No dialogue; cries recede beneath the footsteps.
H01-S01-C02.cameraMovement: Driving lateral track through bodies and bars
continuityLocks: Jesus only as bare feet at endpoint

H01-S02-C01.beat: Rear-only Jesus passes the tormented; His wounded empty hand triggers a demonic alarm and the camera descends into the seized stockade.
H01-S02-C01.dialogueAnchor: Moses: We are not yours. We await the Messiah. Guard: Your Messiah is dead.
H01-S02-C01.shotSizeLens: Rear wide 24mm; wounded-hand close-up 85mm; stockade wide 35mm
H01-S02-C01.cameraMovement: Rear crane, parallel hand track, then fast descending crane

H01-S02-C02.beat: A footstep shakes the stockade; Adam is seized and dragged away as a chain match-cut carries us to the Court hook.
H01-S02-C02.dialogueAnchor: Moses: Then why does Hell tremble?
H01-S02-C02.cameraMovement: Reverse track with Adam, then low rear dolly behind Jesus and rapid chain travel
H01-S02-C02.transition: Chain match cut; hard cut on hook at 01:00

H02-S03-C01.beat: The glowing hook reveals Adam shackled to an iron tree while the masked Torturer demands that he renounce the promise.
H02-S03-C01.dialogueAnchor: Torturer: Say the promise was a lie. Adam: No.
H02-S03-C01.cameraMovement: Slow pullback from ember to full tableau

H02-S03-C02.beat: The hook burns Adam; the demon calls dust a grave, but Adam names himself God's before screaming as the hook tears away.
H02-S03-C02.dialogueAnchor: Torturer: Then name yourself what you are. Adam: His.
H02-S03-C02.cameraMovement: Restrained push-ins; recoil with hook removal

H02-S03-C03.beat: The camera withdraws to reveal the suspended Court, furnace trench, ash rivers and tormented figures trapped in self-chosen consequences.
H02-S03-C03.dialogueAnchor: Tormented voices: How long? One drop. There is no morning here.
H02-S03-C03.cameraMovement: Long crane pullback across infernal geography
H02-S03-C03.transition: Dissolve through furnace smoke to stockade sightline

H02-S04-C01.beat: The newly erected stockade is revealed beside the Court; Eve cries to Adam while Moses reaches the limit of his fresh chain.
H02-S04-C01.dialogueAnchor: Eve: Adam! Moses begins: Release him.
H02-S04-C01.shotSizeLens: Stockade ensemble wide 35mm to Eve close 85mm
H02-S04-C01.cameraMovement: Lateral reveal, then slow push toward Moses
H02-S04-C01.transition: Eyeline cut from Adam to Eve

H02-S04-C02.beat: Moses declares Adam one of the waiting righteous; the Torturer answers that their Messiah is dead.
H02-S04-C02.dialogueAnchor: Moses: Your irons do not make him yours. Torturer: Your Messiah is dead.
H02-S04-C02.cameraMovement: Measured push-pull across the Court gap

H02-S04-C03.beat: Moses says Christ's death caused the illegal raid; the Torturer declares Adam its pledge against Jesus's arrival.
H02-S04-C03.dialogueAnchor: Moses: You know what His death means. Torturer: He will find every soul secured.
H02-S04-C03.shotSizeLens: Low medium on Moses; dominant low angle on Torturer, 50mm
H02-S04-C03.cameraMovement: Slow circular dolly linking Adam and the stockade

H02-S04-C04.beat: Adam is dragged forward as the Torturer blames him before Eve; Eve refuses the lie and accepts her share of the fall.
H02-S04-C04.dialogueAnchor: Torturer: Every funeral began in his mouth. Eve: It began in both of us.
H02-S04-C04.cameraMovement: Low drag track, then rack focus Adam to Eve

H02-S04-C05.beat: The demon recalls Adam blaming Eve; Adam vows never to accuse her again as Eve's dead seed is revealed.
H02-S04-C05.dialogueAnchor: Adam: I will not accuse her again.
H02-S04-C05.cameraMovement: Slow push on Adam, tilt down to Eve's palm
H02-S04-C05.transition: Match dissolve seed to remembered garden earth

H02-S05-C01.beat: Adam remembers God finding and covering them, then promising the woman's Son; demonic eyes open around the Court.
H02-S05-C01.dialogueAnchor: Adam: He promised that the woman's Son would crush the serpent.
H02-S05-C01.shotSizeLens: Adam close 65mm with wide darkness behind
H02-S05-C01.cameraMovement: Gentle push interrupted by eyes emerging in depth

H02-S05-C02.beat: The Torturer mocks the countless sons who have entered Hell and demands to know where Adam's promised Son is.
H02-S05-C02.dialogueAnchor: Torturer: How many sons have entered this kingdom? Where is yours?
H02-S05-C02.shotSizeLens: Torturer medium low angle 50mm; crowd cutaways 85mm
H02-S05-C02.transition: Cut on a single harp note

H02-S05-C03.beat: David plucks the harp's last string and answers that God will not abandon His Holy One; he is still singing.
H02-S05-C03.dialogueAnchor: David: He will not abandon His Holy One to the grave. I am still singing.
H02-S05-C03.cameraMovement: Slow slider toward the vibrating string

H02-S05-C04.beat: John commands stillness; the harp vibrates by itself and one approaching footstep extinguishes every fire.
H02-S05-C04.shotSizeLens: John close 85mm; macro harp; cavern wide 24mm
H02-S05-C04.cameraMovement: Snap rack focus, then locked-off wide for footstep shock

H02-S05-C05.beat: John recognizes the tread from Jordan and announces that Death has taken the One it cannot hold.
H02-S05-C05.dialogueAnchor: Eve: The Lamb? John: The Lamb who was slain is here.
H02-S05-C05.cameraMovement: Slow push on John's returning hope; ground lurch at endpoint

H03-S06-C01.beat: Jesus rounds the last pillar from behind; imprisoned voices recognize Him while the Torturer orders its lines held.
H03-S06-C01.dialogueAnchor: Imprisoned voices: Jesus. Son of David. Remember us. Torturer: He is one dead man.
H03-S06-C01.shotSizeLens: Rear full figure 50mm with deep background
H03-S06-C01.transition: Cut from trembling foundation to footfall

H03-S06-C02.beat: The hook descends, Jesus catches the demon's wrist, shields Adam and kneels without yet showing His face.
H03-S06-C02.dialogueAnchor: No dialogue; ambient sound falls away.
H03-S06-C02.cameraMovement: Fast insert, restrained orbit stopping behind shoulder
continuityLocks: Last clip with face fully withheld

H03-S06-C03.beat: The camera crosses Jesus's wounded shoulder for the first full facial reveal; He names Adam, who remembers His voice.
H03-S06-C03.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Adam. Adam: I remember Your voice.
H03-S06-C03.cameraMovement: Deliberate shoulder cross and gentle push

H03-S06-C04.beat: Jesus asks Adam to look at Him; Adam confesses fear, nakedness and hiding as Jesus touches the collar.
H03-S06-C04.dialogueAnchor: Adam: I was afraid. I was naked. I hid from You.

H03-S06-C05.beat: Jesus tells Adam to hide no longer; the Torturer calls him condemned dust and Jesus rises between them.
H03-S06-C05.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Hide no longer. I have found you. Torturer: You touch condemned dust.
H03-S06-C05.cameraMovement: Vertical pedestal rise into protective composition
H03-S06-C05.transition: Cut on Jesus turning to demon

H03-S07-C01.beat: Jesus orders Adam released; the demon cites his sin, and Jesus answers with the reality of His wounds.
H03-S07-C01.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: His sin is real. So are My wounds.
H03-S07-C01.cameraMovement: Slow push toward raised wounded hand

H03-S07-C02.beat: The demon calls Adam father of every corpse; Jesus names Himself the Life by whom Adam was made.
H03-S07-C02.dialogueAnchor: Torturer: You call this traitor righteous?
H03-S07-C02.shotSizeLens: Torturer low medium; Jesus calm close 85mm

H03-S07-C03.beat: Jesus declares Adam confessed and trusted the promise, bears His image and lies beyond demonic authority.
H03-S07-C03.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: He belongs to Me. You have no authority over him.
H03-S07-C03.shotSizeLens: Jesus hero medium close-up 65mm with Adam behind

H03-S08-C01.beat: Lesser demons emerge and surround Jesus while the Torturer mocks His white burial linen, dried blood and sealed body.
H03-S08-C01.dialogueAnchor: Torturer: Your body lies sealed behind a stone.
H03-S08-C01.cameraMovement: Orbit expanding to reveal demon ring

H03-S08-C02.beat: The Torturer asks the dead man's name; Jesus identifies Himself before the whole underworld.
H03-S08-C02.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Jesus of Nazareth. Son of Man. Son of the living God.

H03-S08-C03.beat: Jesus declares Himself the Living One, alive forever, holder of Death and Hades' keys, with authority over living and dead.
H03-S08-C03.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: I hold the keys of Death and Hades. All authority is Mine.
H03-S08-C03.cameraMovement: Subtle rising crane as voice fills chambers

H03-S08-C04.beat: Jesus says death never entered Him; demonic laughter swells and every attacker lunges on the Torturer's command.
H03-S08-C04.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: I entered death. Death did not enter Me. Torturer: Then die again.
continuityLocks: Jesus does not reach for weapon

H03-S09-C01.beat: Jesus says Enough and releases one clean white-gold pulse that erases the Torturer from inside its mask.
H03-S09-C01.shotSizeLens: Centered wide 32mm with mask macro insert

H03-S09-C02.beat: Outer demons become ash, weapons vanish and Adam's restraints fall while the stockade chains only warm and groan.
H03-S09-C02.dialogueAnchor: No dialogue; ash and broken iron settle.
H03-S09-C02.cameraMovement: Pulse-following sweep from Court to stockade

H03-S09-C03.beat: Jesus offers His left hand; Adam fears the hands that opened death, then clasps the Redeemer's forearm.
H03-S09-C03.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Then place your hand in Mine.
H03-S09-C03.cameraMovement: Gentle push and low lift preparation

H03-S09-C04.beat: The Second Adam raises the first; Adam names the promised Son and Jesus leads him toward the kneeling stockade.
H03-S09-C04.dialogueAnchor: Adam: The promised Son. Jesus: The promise has found you.
H03-S09-C04.shotSizeLens: Low full two-shot 35mm rising to procession wide
H03-S09-C04.cameraMovement: Powerful vertical lift, then side track

H04-S10-C01.beat: Jesus touches the many locked chains on the stockade gate; every lock turns gold and the gate silently opens.
H04-S10-C01.shotSizeLens: Gate wide 35mm; wounded palm and locks 85mm
continuityLocks: Gate is stockade gate, not Last Gate

H04-S10-C02.beat: Eve runs through the opening and embraces Adam; for the first time since Eden neither hides from the other.
H04-S10-C02.dialogueAnchor: Eve: I thought I would watch him take you forever.
H04-S10-C02.cameraMovement: Handheld rush with Eve, then stabilized intimate hold

H04-S10-C03.beat: Adam says the Torturer asked him to accuse Eve and he refused; Eve turns toward Jesus's right-side wound.
H04-S10-C03.cameraMovement: Slow arc from couple to Jesus
H04-S10-C03.transition: Rack focus to fixed side stain

H04-S10-C04.beat: Eve asks what was done to Him; Jesus explains that His life was freely given, not taken.
H04-S10-C04.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: My life was not taken from Me. I gave it.

H04-S10-C05.beat: Jesus answers that her worth was never small; Eve confesses believing the first lie and giving her children graves.
H04-S10-C05.dialogueAnchor: Eve: I gave my children a world of graves.
H04-S10-C05.shotSizeLens: Intimate close-up 85mm with Adam soft behind

H04-S10-C06.beat: Jesus recalls mercy's promise and raises Eve as mother of the living; her wrist chain falls open.
H04-S10-C06.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Rise, mother of the living.
H04-S10-C06.shotSizeLens: Hands and chain close 85mm; rising two-shot 50mm

H04-S11-C01.beat: Abraham recalls leaving his father's house for an unseen country and Jesus honors that he went.
H04-S11-C01.dialogueAnchor: Abraham: You called me to seek a country I could not see. Jesus: And you went.
H04-S11-C01.cameraMovement: Slow lateral slide revealing stars motif in smoke
continuityLocks: Abraham remains chained until scene end

H04-S11-C02.beat: Abraham asks if this is the mountain beyond all mountains; Jesus names it the valley beneath them all.
continuityLocks: No Last Gate close reveal yet

H04-S11-C03.beat: Jesus promises the city built by God; Abraham recognizes the embodied Promise and his chains fall untouched.
H04-S11-C03.dialogueAnchor: Abraham: The Promise now stands before me.

H04-S12-C01.beat: Moses recalls the unconsuming fire, divided sea and glory seen only from behind, then dying outside the land.
H04-S12-C01.dialogueAnchor: Moses: Yet I died outside the land of promise.
H04-S12-C01.cameraMovement: Slow push through split staff silhouette

H04-S12-C02.beat: Jesus promises Moses will cross with no Pharaoh following; the staff restores and death begins answering His face.
H04-S12-C02.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Today you cross. And no Pharaoh follows.
H04-S12-C02.cameraMovement: Tilt from hand on shoulder to restoring staff
H04-S12-C02.transition: Restored wood match-cuts to harp frame

H04-S13-C01.beat: David says his song failed when earth closed over Jesus; Jesus assures him that trembling faith remains faith.
H04-S13-C01.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Faith may tremble and still be faith.
H04-S13-C01.cameraMovement: Slow side dolly around broken harp
H04-S13-C01.transition: Cut on David touching last string

H04-S13-C02.beat: David offers his one string; Jesus says Heaven has enough, and golden strings restore themselves across the harp.
H04-S13-C02.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Then Heaven has enough to begin.

H04-S13-C03.beat: Jesus tells David to sing what only the free can finish; one restored chord resonates through the entire stockade.
H04-S13-C03.dialogueAnchor: David: What song does a prisoner sing? Jesus: The one only the free can finish.
H04-S13-C03.shotSizeLens: David medium 65mm expanding to stockade wide 24mm
H04-S13-C03.cameraMovement: Pullback riding the chord through prisoners

H04-S14-C01.beat: Isaiah recounts seeing the despised Servant carrying grief and wounds; Jesus confirms that he saw truly.
H04-S14-C01.dialogueAnchor: Isaiah: I saw our grief upon Your shoulders. Jesus: You saw truly.
H04-S14-C01.transition: Cut on Isaiah looking down the road

H04-S14-C02.beat: Jesus says no prophet saw the whole road; Isaiah realizes sorrow never had the final word and rises.
H04-S14-C02.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: It never did. Isaiah: The Lord is here.
H04-S14-C02.shotSizeLens: Low two-shot 50mm into Isaiah proclamation wide 35mm
H04-S14-C02.cameraMovement: Rise with Isaiah, then pivot to crowd

H04-S15-C01.beat: John asks whether he must prepare Jesus's way even here; Jesus commissions him one final time.
H04-S15-C01.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: One final time, faithful herald.
H04-S15-C01.cameraMovement: Slow approach ending as John turns
continuityLocks: John still chained until turn or individually released

H04-S15-C02.beat: John proclaims the Lamb slain yet standing and the Light darkness could not overcome; the crowd surges forward.
H04-S15-C02.dialogueAnchor: John: Behold the Lamb of God—slain, yet standing!
H04-S15-C02.shotSizeLens: John low medium 50mm to crowd wide 24mm

H04-S15-C03.beat: Waiting souls ask whether it is finished, whether Heaven remembers them and whether they are forgiven.
H04-S15-C03.dialogueAnchor: Waiting souls: Is it truly finished? Does Heaven still remember us? Are we forgiven?

H04-S15-C04.beat: A mother asks about her child and an old soldier about cleansing; Jesus mounts the central foundation to answer all.
H04-S15-C04.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Prisoners of hope—children of the promise—hear Me.
H04-S15-C04.shotSizeLens: Portrait inserts 85mm to Jesus elevated wide 35mm
H04-S15-C04.cameraMovement: Crane upward with Jesus onto platform

H05-S16-C01.beat: The multitude quiets as Jesus declares that He endured judgment and drank the cup.
H05-S16-C01.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: I have endured the judgment. I have drunk the cup.
H05-S16-C01.shotSizeLens: Elevated hero medium 50mm with crowd foreground

H05-S16-C02.beat: He says He bore sin without yielding and death without belonging, and none were forgotten in dust or silence.
H05-S16-C02.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: You were not forgotten in the dust. You were not abandoned in the silence.

H05-S16-C03.beat: Every prayer, tear and promise is acknowledged; hope visibly travels through the prisoners like wind.
H05-S16-C03.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Every prayer was heard. Every tear was known. Every promise has found its answer.

H05-S16-C04.beat: Jesus commands them to rise because His love is faithful, not because their waiting was flawless.
H05-S16-C04.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Rise—not because your waiting was flawless, but because My love is faithful.
H05-S16-C04.cameraMovement: Slow push, then tilt toward lifting faces
H05-S16-C04.transition: Cut on first prisoner beginning to rise

H05-S16-C05.beat: He calls them remembered rather than shadows, steps among them and announces the long night is ending.
H05-S16-C05.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Rise—as those remembered by God. The long night is ending.
H05-S16-C05.cameraMovement: Steadicam descends from platform alongside Jesus

H05-S16-C06.beat: Jesus says Come out and opens both wounded hands; a warm ring of radiance travels across the stockade floor.
H05-S16-C06.cameraMovement: Circular crane rising over expanding ring
H05-S16-C06.transition: Radiance crosses frame into chain cascade

H05-S17-C01.beat: Every unlawful chain breaks in one thunderous cascade; prisoners stare at empty wrists and the carried lamp flares white.
H05-S17-C01.dialogueAnchor: No dialogue; millions of links strike stone.
H05-S17-C01.shotSizeLens: Ultra-wide 18mm with wrist and lamp inserts 85mm

H05-S17-C02.beat: Stockade bars split, the multitude erupts and David strikes his restored harp to call the everlasting doors open.
H05-S17-C02.dialogueAnchor: David: Open, you everlasting doors! Souls: The King has entered!
H05-S17-C02.shotSizeLens: Breaking bars wide 24mm to David medium 65mm
H05-S17-C02.cameraMovement: Push through splitting bars into crowd
continuityLocks: This is stockade destruction, not Last Gate

H05-S17-C03.beat: The Shepherd call-and-response grows from human voices into orchestral procession as freedom fills the Pit.
H05-S17-C03.dialogueAnchor: David: The Shepherd has found His own. Souls: The night has an ending!
H05-S17-C03.shotSizeLens: Crowd wide 24mm with hero portrait inserts

H05-S18-C01.beat: The Last Gate, keyhole and kneeling armor are revealed; something immense moves behind it and Satan welcomes their hope.
H05-S18-C01.dialogueAnchor: Satan off-screen: Let Him gather them. Hope makes the final binding sweeter.
H05-S18-C01.cameraMovement: Slow ominous push toward city-sized keyhole
H05-S18-C01.transition: Cut on distant anthem; red helms ignite

H06-S19-C01.beat: Moses raises the restored staff and orders forward as Jesus leads Adam, Eve, patriarchs and innumerable freed souls.
H06-S19-C01.transition: Cut from ignited helms to Moses's raised staff

H06-S19-C02.beat: The procession becomes a river from blue shadow into gold as David declares the prison could not hold the King.
H06-S19-C02.dialogueAnchor: David: The King has entered the prison. Souls: And the prison could not hold Him.
H06-S19-C02.cameraMovement: Lateral aerial glide along river of faces

H06-S19-C03.beat: The Shepherd response carries them over the final terrace until tormented souls crowd the lattices and call to Jesus.
H06-S19-C03.dialogueAnchor: Souls: He has found His own. Tormented soul: Son of David!
H06-S19-C03.cameraMovement: Side track slowing to a stop

H06-S20-C01.beat: Jesus stops in grief before a tormented king whose crown is fused to his hands; the king begs Him to break the bars.
H06-S20-C01.dialogueAnchor: Tormented King: Break these bars for us!
continuityLocks: Jesus does not free tormented king

H06-S20-C02.beat: Jesus says mercy called during life and the king crowned himself against it; the king demands another call.
H06-S20-C02.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Mercy called to you among the living. You crowned yourself against it.

H06-S20-C03.beat: Jesus says the king hears Him even now, but the king cannot release his crown; Jesus leaves in solemn grief.
H06-S20-C03.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: You hear My voice even now.
H06-S20-C03.cameraMovement: Pull away with Jesus while king remains fixed

H06-S21-C01.beat: Adam remembers light before the sun and a world without fear; Eve remembers God walking toward them.
H06-S21-C01.dialogueAnchor: Eve: I remember the sound of God walking toward us.

H06-S21-C02.beat: Adam recalls running from that sound; Jesus stops and tells them they are not running now.
H06-S21-C02.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: You are not running now.
H06-S21-C02.cameraMovement: Dolly stops with Jesus; subtle pivot to Adam

H06-S21-C03.beat: Adam says Jesus came farther down than humanity fell; Eve reveals the dead seed and asks whether the garden will take them back.
H06-S21-C03.dialogueAnchor: Adam: You came down farther than we fell. Eve: Will the garden take us back?
H06-S21-C03.cameraMovement: Slow track, then tilt to Eve's palm

H06-S21-C04.beat: Jesus says the road does not lead backward but toward His Father's house.
H06-S21-C04.cameraMovement: Gentle forward push then pan toward ascent

H06-S21-C05.beat: Adam asks Home; Jesus gives His first true smile and says Home, which the entire multitude softly repeats.
H06-S21-C05.dialogueAnchor: Adam: Home? Jesus: Home. Souls: Home.
H06-S21-C05.shotSizeLens: Jesus smile close 85mm expanding to wide 24mm

H06-S22-C01.beat: The quiet chorus enters a cavern with its own weather; the camera rises until the intact Last Gate fills the horizon.
H06-S22-C01.dialogueAnchor: No new dialogue; soft Home chorus.
H06-S22-C01.cameraMovement: Long crane rise and forward reveal

H07-S23-C01.beat: The souls stop before battlements packed with legions while Moses and Abraham compare them to Egypt's armies and uncounted stars.
H07-S23-C01.dialogueAnchor: Moses: More than Egypt's armies. Abraham: More than the stars I counted.
H07-S23-C01.shotSizeLens: Extreme wide 18mm with leader close inserts 85mm

H07-S23-C02.beat: John tells every demon to witness; Jesus walks forward alone as the Gate bulges and its architecture begins to break.
H07-S23-C02.dialogueAnchor: John: Then let every one of them witness.
H07-S23-C02.shotSizeLens: John medium 65mm to Jesus lone full wide 24mm
H07-S23-C02.cameraMovement: Rear track with Jesus, then tilt to bulging Gate

H07-S23-C03.beat: Colossal Satan wearing Death tears free, revealing tomb-door wings, accusation armor, black keys and the cold of the first lie.
H07-S23-C03.dialogueAnchor: No dialogue; the freed multitude recoils.
H07-S23-C03.shotSizeLens: Extreme low ultra-wide 14mm with detail inserts 85mm
H07-S23-C03.cameraMovement: Vertical tilt from feet to broken horn crown
continuityLocks: Satan and Death are one character

H07-S24-C01.beat: Satan mocks the dead carpenter leading rebels to an unopened door; Jesus gives one calm command.
H07-S24-C01.dialogueAnchor: Satan: There you are. Jesus: Move.
H07-S24-C01.cameraMovement: Slow push from Satan toward still Jesus

H07-S24-C02.beat: Satan claims everything Jesus touched in his kingdom; Jesus distinguishes temporary custody from ownership.
H07-S24-C02.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: You mistook custody for ownership.
H07-S24-C02.cameraMovement: Slow parallax showing souls between them

H07-S24-C03.beat: Satan says everything that dies becomes his; Jesus states that He died but never became Satan's.
H07-S24-C03.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: I died. I did not become yours.

H07-S24-C04.beat: Satan orders Jesus to see His triumph and names Adam, Eve and Abraham's failures as accusations ignite on his armor.
H07-S24-C04.dialogueAnchor: Satan: The man who blamed his wife. The woman who distrusted her God.
H07-S24-C04.cameraMovement: Pan from glowing armor inscriptions to named souls

H07-S24-C05.beat: Satan adds Moses, David, prophets and kings; Jesus answers their bowed shame by naming them redeemed.
H07-S24-C05.dialogueAnchor: Satan: You call them righteous? Jesus: I call them redeemed.
H07-S24-C05.shotSizeLens: Portrait montage 85mm to Jesus centered medium 65mm
H07-S24-C05.cameraMovement: Descending gaze then firm push to Jesus

H07-S24-C06.beat: Satan says their guilt is written into him; Jesus displays His wounds and says love fulfills the record.
H07-S24-C06.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: Their guilt is real. So are My wounds. Love fulfills it.
H07-S24-C06.shotSizeLens: Wounded hands and right side 85mm; face close 85mm

H07-S24-C07.beat: Satan offers the patriarchs but demands Adam and Eve; Jesus explicitly says He came for both.
H07-S24-C07.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: I came for Adam. I came for Eve.
H07-S24-C07.cameraMovement: Lateral move linking Jesus to first pair

H07-S25-C01.beat: Jesus says there is no one He did not come for; Satan opens the Gate inward into blackness and summons the Abyss.
H07-S25-C01.dialogueAnchor: Jesus: There is no one among them I did not come for. Satan: Legions of the Abyss!
H07-S25-C01.cameraMovement: Pullback from Jesus into opening black void

H07-S25-C02.beat: Ranked demons pour from battlements, walls and sky until they surround the procession in a mile-deep circle.
H07-S25-C02.shotSizeLens: Aerial extreme wide 14mm with creature inserts
H07-S25-C02.cameraMovement: Rapid descending crane and 360-degree surround reveal

H07-S25-C03.beat: Moses orders the people together; Satan commands Chain the dust, the keyhole turns and millions of chains erupt.
H07-S25-C03.dialogueAnchor: Moses: Stand together! Satan: CHAIN THE DUST!
H07-S25-C03.shotSizeLens: Moses low medium 50mm; keyhole and chain wide 24mm
H07-S25-C03.cameraMovement: Whip pan staff to keyhole; explosive radial camera retreat

H07-S25-C04.beat: Adam and Eve are torn apart while Abraham, Moses, David, Isaiah and John are forced down and restrained.
H07-S25-C04.dialogueAnchor: No dialogue beyond cries and Moses rallying.

H07-S25-C05.beat: The river of light becomes a field of prisoners; chains wrap Jesus's arms, chest and ankles, and He permits them to tighten.
H07-S25-C05.dialogueAnchor: No dialogue; Satan watches Jesus allow the binding.
